profile.headline: Staff Developer at Teladoc Health
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience building scalable platforms, data‑driven applications, and user‑centered experiences across healthcare and enterprise environments. My work spans frontend and backend architecture, platform engineering, and systems that support analytics and AI‑enabled workflows.
I collaborate closely with cross‑functional partners, Product, Data, AI/ML, DevOps, and Security, to define platform strategy, shape Data & AI initiatives, and ensure solutions are reliable, compliant, and aligned with business priorities. I design backend services and integration patterns in Python and Node.js, and deliver robust, accessible interfaces using JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, HTML, and CSS.
As a technical leader, I’m passionate about mentorship, architectural clarity, and elevating engineering quality. I focus on empowering teams through best practices, stronger CI/CD pipelines, scalable design patterns, and platform capabilities that accelerate AI‑driven and data‑centric development.
My goal is to combine strategic thinking with hands‑on expertise to build platforms that enable intelligence, insight, and innovation at scale, especially in complex, regulated domains like healthcare.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
.	Contribute to design, implementation, testing, and deployment of "Lilee T-Clould" application. The site is for managing Lilee’s assets devices running on Docker containers, using Angular 4, HTML5, Bootstrap, Ruby, PostgreSQL and AWS.
.	Design, develop and deploy PTC Train Control systems. The application provides the capability to monitor and troubleshoot multiple network components, such as GPS, Wi-Fi, radios, antennas, base stations. PTC solution is build using Angular 4, CSS3, PHP, HTML5, MySQL and Python.
.	Develop unit tests and perform the validation using contemporary tools, moving to towards continuous development/continuous integration.
.	Work collaboratively in a cross-functional and Agile team of UX designers, architects and quality developers.
.	Tracked and solved tickets for defects on bug reporting tool (JIRA).

positions.title: Full Stack LIMS Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and deployed a real-time web based Dashboard samples monitoring system for CCL, Process Development, QA, and Operations departments. The site is a stand-alone utility designed to provide a quick look at various types of data within Caridodx’s LIMS using Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, jQuery, MySQL and Oracle databases.

•	Developing and maintaining an online portal for clinicians to access Corus CAD patient reports, communicate with CardioDx, download resources and view practice-related dashboards. This application is developed using Ruby on Rail, JavaScript, jQuery and Postgresql. 

•	Designed and developed a data warehouse solution for report generation using Ruby, Tableu and CloverETL, data transfer to and from Salesforce.com.

positions.title: Full Stack LIMS Developer
positions.description:
•	Programming languages: Java – ten years of commercial experience in developing code in Java, Swing, AWT, JDBC, Servlets, JSP, PHP, XML, XSL, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, C#, Perl and R.
•	Bioinformatics: familiarity with public domain sequence repositories (GenBank, UC Santa Cruz, dbSNP), tools for sequence database searching (NCBI BLAST), BioPerl.
•	Graphic design and Photo editing: Proficient user of Flash, Action Script, Dreamweaver, Photoshop CS.

Web Servers: Apache Http Server, Apache Tomcat 6.0.
DBMS used: DB2 9.0, MySql, Oracle 8I.

•	Implemented User Interface for http://www.pathworkdx.net which enables external labs and MD offices to request diagnostics tests. Pathologist and MDs can view labs results, analyze and compare data.
•	Developed site portal using JSP, HTML, JavaScript, XML, CSS and Eclipse IDE.
•	Develop backend using J2EE technology: Java, Struts, Servlet, JavaBeans, JDBC connection to DB2 using Apache and Tomcat Web server.
•	Designed and implemented, backup and restore procedures for DB2 database server running under Windows and Linux RedHat OS system.
•	Installed and maintained Apache and Tomcat Web servers running under Windows and Linux RedHat OS system.

•	Created a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) for Pathwork Laboratory to keep track, modify and process patients samples from extraction to amplification and generate gene chip for scanning.  This application processed multiple file types generated by various labotory devices. It was developed using Java, DB2v.9, and provides a Swing UI.
 
•	Developed Pathchip Assay Library which ran on Affymetrix DX2 systems and generated CHP, CEL and EXP files. This is a customized software library which allows Pathwork to scan its proprietary GeneChip own chip using Affy platform. The library was developed using mainly C#.
